story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price ICICIBANK to move about ±4.5%, roughly 1,530 to 1,675. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 62% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much ICICIBANK has actually been moving: they price 19.2% a year while the last month realised 32.6%.
ICICIBANK has actually been moving about 2.05% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.5 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for ICICIBANK: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.

iv.simple: Options on ICICIBANK are priced for moves of about 1.21% a day. That is normal for ICICIBANK compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 19.2%: 58th percentile of 1 year, 24th of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much ICICIBANK has actually been moving: they price 19.2% a year while the last month realised 32.6%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -13.4 vol points, 0th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 70% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Longer-dated options on ICICIBANK cost more than near ones: the normal, calm shape.

skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.48 vol pts (front month), 76th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.analyst: RV21 32.6% (98th percentile of the past year), RV5 44.0%, RV63 25.0%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 94th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 1,650 (+3.6% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 1,400 (-12.1%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.69; all-expiry OI PCR at the 50th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +1,573,600, puts +1,134,700 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: ICICIBANK futures trade 9.5 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 6.8% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +9.5, annualised carry 6.8% (57th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.4%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Long unwinding, Long build-up, Short build-up, Short build-up. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price ICICIBANK to move about ±4.5%, roughly 1,530 to 1,675. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 62% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 4.51% (forward 1,602.3). Scored on 1,955 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: ICICIBANK has used 13% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
